title: The Next New Thing
author: Andrew Warner
summary: Near-daily short-form coverage of AI tooling and agent workflows, hosted by Andrew Warner (of Mixergy) and presented by Zapier. The channel's stated angle is how to build profitable AI startups, but the actual output is closer to a scouting feed: new agent tools, GitHub repo round-ups, MCP servers, local models and hardware, usually framed around what it costs and whether it works. Useful as a source of leads on tooling rather than depth on any one thing.
provenance: Channel metadata from the YouTube about page; recent-video sample from the channel RSS feed. No transcripts fetched — this is a source anchor, not a video capture.
